differences.what: The brand mark reads in A and is lost in B: A's white 'earmilk' stands out on the red plinth (about 203 against 51); B's letters are dark brown on red (about 33 against 62-71), a muddy smudge.

B's brand red goes coral on the sunlit faces: its right plinth face sits at (255,94,77) with the red channel clipped in 78% of its pixels, its gable-end triangle a flat salmon, so the carton reads as two different reds. A keeps one deep red in light and shade.

In B the wall left of and above the sun patch is a near-black block (about 2.5, 75% crushed) with no visible cause, swallowing the chair rail; in A the shaded wall and the cast shadow keep their detail.
A's woofer does not read as a driver: the hard sun puts a crescent and a sharp white shard inside the cone. B's woofer reads cleanly as a real driver.
B makes the product the hero: larger (72% of frame height) at a true three-quarter angle showing the carton's volume; A is smaller and nearly front-on.
A is low-key to the point of murk: the right third of the wall about 12 and the foreground floor about 41. B's sunlit floor has a glossy plank texture and diagonal light leading to the product.
A's horn shows the tweeter centred with clean speculars; in B the tweeter is a third hidden behind the lip and the gable end's diagonal edge is stair-stepped with a red fringe.
A's set is more convincing: the sun patch wraps over the chair rail; in B the cast shadow's fin reads as a hooked beak.
